name: Sniper Shot
body:
School divination; Level cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, legendary ninja 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

A quick word of luck and a sharp breath ensures a sure shot. The next ranged attack roll you make can add precision damage regardless of distance and gains a bonus on critical confirmation rolls equal to your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (whichever is higher).
